interpretation_ko: 형편이 좋게 바뀌고, 전보다 얻는 것에 흡족해할 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells favorable turns in conditions, and you will be more pleased with your gains than formerly

cite.original: To dream of rabbits, foretells favorable turns in conditions, and you will be more pleased with your gains than formerly.
cite.translation_ko: 토끼 꿈은, 형편이 좋게 바뀌고, 전보다 얻는 것에 흡족해할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes faithfulness in love, to the married or single

cite.original: To see white rabbits, denotes faithfulness in love, to the married or single.
cite.translation_ko: 흰 토끼를 보는 꿈은, 기혼이든 미혼이든 사랑에 신실할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that children will contribute to your joys

cite.original: To see rabbits frolicing about, denotes that children will contribute to your joys.
cite.translation_ko: 토끼들이 뛰노는 것을 보는 꿈은, 아이들이 저의 기쁨이 될 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 원수가 다정한 겉모습으로 속이고 있다는 뜻
interpretation_en: denotes you are being deceived by the friendly appearance of enemies

cite.original: To dream of a raccoon, denotes you are being deceived by the friendly appearance of enemies.
cite.translation_ko: 너구리 꿈은, 원수가 다정한 겉모습으로 속이고 있다는 뜻이다

interpretation_ko: 남들이 제가 가지려 애쓰는 것을 탐낼 조짐. 다만 경주에서 이기면 경쟁자를 이겨낼 것
interpretation_en: foretells that others will aspire to the things you are working to possess, but if you win in the race, you will overcome your competitors

cite.original: To dream that you are in a race, foretells that others will aspire to the things you are working to possess, but if you win in the race, you will overcome your competitors.
cite.translation_ko: 제가 경주에 나서는 꿈은, 남들이 제가 가지려 애쓰는 것을 탐낼 조짐이다. 다만 경주에서 이기면 경쟁자를 이겨낼 것이다

interpretation_ko: 어떤 약속의 결과를 몰라 애태우게 될 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes the uncertainty of the outcome of some engagement which gives you much anxious thought

cite.original: To dream of a rack, denotes the uncertainty of the outcome of some engagement which gives you much anxious thought.
cite.translation_ko: 고문틀 꿈은, 어떤 약속의 결과를 몰라 애태우게 될 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will be foiled in some anticipated pleasure

cite.original: To dream of a racket, denotes that you will be foiled in some anticipated pleasure.
cite.translation_ko: 소란 꿈은, 바라던 즐거움이 어그러질 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 마음에 두던 놀이에 끼지 못해 실망할 흉조
interpretation_en: this dream is ominous of disappointment in not being able to participate in some amusement that has engaged her attention

cite.original: For a young woman, this dream is ominous of disappointment in not being able to participate in some amusement that has engaged her attention.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 소란 꿈을 꾸면, 마음에 두던 놀이에 끼지 못해 실망할 흉조다
